editorial:
Imagine heading to a gorgeous tropical resort for a friend's wedding, only for things to go south fast. You follow Meg and Kayla, a couple who are already on the rocks after a scary run-in with some hateful people. Their friends try to play matchmaker and fix the relationship during the trip, but the vibe shifts from romantic to terrifying during a boat trip. Once the group gets stranded, the movie stops being about relationship drama and turns into a fight for survival. It feels like a vacation gone wrong, where the beautiful scenery just makes the scary parts feel even more intense.

The acting is solid and the tension builds up in a way that keeps you glued to your seat. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of horror, the fast pace makes up for it. You will love the way the suspense ramps up toward the end. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to really soak in those island views, or rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a weekend binge with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a brutal fight for survival as the girls realize they are being hunted. After a series of shocking deaths, the survivors have to fight back against the killers. The final twist reveals that the danger was closer than they thought. In the end, the few remaining girls manage to escape the nightmare, though they are left scarred by the trauma and the loss of their friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and vacation nightmares.
